# Code Demos

Each week includes an in-class code demo with narrative explanation, executable code, and links to standalone source files.

## Available Demos

- [Week 1: First Python Program](demos/week-01.qmd) — [`week-01-demo.py`](demos/week-01-demo.py)

## How to Add a New Demo

1. Create `demos/week-NN.qmd` using `demos/week-01.qmd` as a template.
2. Create `demos/week-NN-demo.py` (or `.R`, `.jl`, etc.) with the standalone script.
3. Add a link on this page.
4. Add the `.qmd` file to the sidebar in `_quarto.yml` under the "Demos" section.
5. Run `quarto render` to rebuild the site.
